posts.text: Dario's comments on the state of the technology are largely agreeable, as he said "experts largely agree," but he also combined it with forecasts of what comes next, which experts do not agree. Is a persuasive way of talking, he's good at what he does.

posts.quoted: 3/ Rise of open source: OSS models are quickly increasing in token share amongst enterprises, growing from nearly zero to 30% in the 5 month period. Anecdotally, we see those models used mostly to reduce costs on high volume workloads (large batch workloads, coding, etc).
